title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Wikimedia…
description: A low-severity cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Wikimedia Foundation MediaWiki UrlShortener Extension affecting versions 1.43, 1.45, 1.46, and 1.47. The issue stems from improper neutralization of input during web page generation in the includes/SpecialUrlShortener.php file. No patch or remediation details are provided in the available data.
